top_verse_en: So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables: "How can Satan drive out Satan?

refs.t_en: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
Jesus spoke all these things to the crowds in parables. He did not tell them anything without using a parable.
Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand. . . .
But Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, "Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and a house divided against a house will fall. . . .

outline.text_en: convinces the blasphemy of casting out demons by Beelzebub;
and shows who are his brother, sister, and mother.

parallel_en.text: And He called them to Himself and began speaking to them in parables, "How can Satan cast out Satan?
And he called them unto him, and said unto them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?
So He summoned them and spoke to them in parables: "How can Satan drive out Satan?
So Jesus called them together and began to speak to them in parables. "How can Satan drive out Satan?
So he called them and spoke to them in parables: "How can Satan cast out Satan?
And Yeshua called them, and he said to them in parables, “How is Satan able to cast out Satan?”
